### `TypeStepName` (enum)

A step of the style's type ramp.

A string: one of the variants below. The zero value is `"body"`.

| Variant | Doc |
|---|---|
| `"body"` | The default step. |
| `"xs"` | A step of the ramp. |
| `"meta"` | A step of the ramp. |
